_anchorNote: Picked candidate 2 of 5 -- the un-pedestrianised eastern section of High Street, which is the stretch the buses use: 9 m from Stop R and 31 m from Stop S. Candidate 1 is the pedestrianised High Street 96 m west (no bus stops on it), candidates 3 and 4 are a different High Street in Downley 2.5 km away. resolve_place.py defaulted region to 'Cambridgeshire'; corrected by hand to Buckinghamshire. Frame radius for the boarding plan is routes.json boardingPlan.frameRadiusM (200 m), NOT this walkshed. 200 m and not the 252 m maxOK of frame-coverage_2026-08-23.md: at 224 m the frame admits Station Interchange Stop X1 alone, whose CommonName is unique in frame only because X2 (230 m) and X3 (241 m) fall outside it -- the sheet would print 'Station Interchange' as a boarding point and a reader would arrive to find three flags. At 200 m the frame is the six stops of the town-wide letter series plus Crendon Street, and is stable for any radius from 139 m to 223 m.
